sales_delivery_lines.title: Tổng hợp xuất kho bán hàng (HDA: ph81/ct81)
sales_delivery_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.status::text AS status, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien2 AS revenue_vnd, d.tien_nt2 AS revenue_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph81 h JOIN public.ct81 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'HDA' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.ma_gd <> 4 AND h.status::text IN ('1', '2') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_order_lines.title: Tổng hợp đơn đặt hàng bán (SO1: ph64/ct64)
sales_order_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(nullif(d.so_po, ''), '') AS po_kh, h.status::text AS status, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien2 AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt2 AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS order_id FROM public.ph64 h JOIN public.ct64 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'SO1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

purchase_order_lines.title: Tổng hợp đơn đặt hàng mua (PO1: ph94/ct94)
purchase_order_lines.notes: day (ngay_ct) là Ngày lập đơn PO; required_date (ct94.ngay_yc) là Ngày nhận hàng yêu cầu. Mã nhân viên (dmkh) lọc theo 'requester' hoặc 'in_charge'; username đăng nhập ERP lọc theo 'creator_user'.
purchase_order_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS po_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, coalesce(h.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(h.ma_nvbh, '') AS requester, coalesce(req.ten_kh, '') AS requester_name, coalesce(h.nguoi_phu_trach, '') AS in_charge, coalesce(pic.ten_kh, '') AS in_charge_name, coalesce(cr.user_name, '') AS creator_user, coalesce(cr.ten, '') AS creator_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_yc AS required_date, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt AS amount_orig, d.gia AS unit_price_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph94 h JOIN public.ct94 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmkh req ON req.ma_kh = h.ma_nvbh LEFT JOIN public.dmkh pic ON pic.ma_kh = h.nguoi_phu_trach LEFT JOIN public.userinfo cr ON cr.user_id = h.user_id0 LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PO1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('0', '14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_requests.title: Tổng hợp phiếu yêu cầu / đề nghị mua hàng (PR0: ph91/ct91)
purchase_requests.notes: day (ngay_ct) là Ngày lập phiếu; required_date (ct91.ngay_yc) là Ngày nhận hàng yêu cầu. Mã nhân viên (dmkh) lọc theo trường 'requester'; username đăng nhập ERP lọc theo 'creator_user'.
purchase_requests.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS pr_no, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_yc AS required_date, coalesce(h.ma_bp, d.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(h.ma_nv, '') AS requester, coalesce(req.ten_kh, '') AS requester_name, coalesce(cr.user_name, '') AS creator_user, coalesce(cr.ten, '') AS creator_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, trim(coalesce(h.status::text, '')) AS status, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, d.so_luong AS quantity, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph91 h JOIN public.ct91 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh req ON req.ma_kh = h.ma_nv LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PR0' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text LEFT JOIN public.userinfo cr ON cr.user_id = h.user_id0 JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('0', '14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_receipt_lines.title: Tổng hợp phiếu nhập mua hàng từ NCC (PR1: ph77/ct77)
purchase_receipt_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_po1, '') AS po_no, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph77 h JOIN public.ct77 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PR1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text IN ('1', '11', '12') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

inventory_movements.title: Tổng hợp phát sinh nhập xuất kho trong kỳ (ct70)
inventory_movements.source_sql: SELECT c.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, c.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(c.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, trim(coalesce(c.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, c.so_ct AS doc_no, c.ngay_ct AS day, c.sl_nhap AS in_qty, c.sl_xuat AS out_qty, c.tien_nhap AS in_amount_vnd, c.tien_xuat AS out_amount_vnd, c.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ct70 c LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = c.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (c.ma_ct NOT IN ('PXB', 'PNF') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ph85 b WHERE c.so_ct = b.so_ct AND b.ma_kho = b.ma_khon)) AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR c.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ','))))

mes_downtime_lines.title: Thống kê dừng máy / dừng chuyền MES (mes_oi_stop_line)
mes_downtime_lines.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.error_code, '') AS reason_code, coalesce(d.ten_loi, '') AS reason_name, coalesce(d.nh_nndungmay1, '') AS reason_group, a.create_date AS day, round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS stop_minutes, a.id AS event_id FROM public.mes_oi_stop_line a LEFT JOIN public.dmnndungmay d ON d.ma_loi = a.error_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01'

mes_ng_defects.title: Thống kê phế phẩm / lỗi sản xuất NG MES (mes_oi_ng_confirm)
mes_ng_defects.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.error_code, '') AS defect_code, coalesce(l.ten_loi, '') AS defect_name, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(a.ng_qty, 0) AS ng_qty, a.id_oi_ng AS record_id FROM public.mes_oi_ng_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.dmloi l ON l.ma_loi = a.error_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

qc_iqc_lines.title: Thống kê kiểm tra chất lượng hàng mua IQC (phiqc)
qc_iqc_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_ncc AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, h.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(h.ket_qua::text, '') AS qc_result, coalesce(h.so_luong, 0) AS lot_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ok, 0) AS ok_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ng, 0) AS ng_qty, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phiqc h LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_ncc LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = h.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_production_output.title: Sản lượng sản xuất MES theo máy, ca, lệnh SX (mes_oi_confirm)
mes_production_output.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(l.line_group_code3, '') AS line_group, CASE WHEN a.create_time >= TIME '08:00:00' AND a.create_time < TIME '20:00:00' THEN 'Ca ngày (08-20h)' ELSE 'Ca đêm (20-08h)' END AS shift, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.step_code, '') AS step, coalesce(a.station_code, '') AS station, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS planned_qty, coalesce(a.complete, 0) AS complete_qty, coalesce(a.packing, 0) AS packing_qty, coalesce(a.ng, 0) AS ng_qty, coalesce(a.skip_shot, 0) AS skip_shot, CASE WHEN a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01' THEN round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS run_minutes, a.id_oi AS run_id FROM public.mes_oi_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.mflist_line l ON l.line_code = a.machine_code JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(a.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_work_orders.title: Lệnh sản xuất và tiến độ kế hoạch WO (mes_scheduling_output)
mes_work_orders.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.mes_scheduling_code AS schedule_code, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.mold_code, '') AS mold, coalesce(s.statusname, a.status_wo::text, '') AS wo_status, coalesce(a.work_center_code, b.work_center_code, '') AS work_center, a.start_date AS day, coalesce(a.uom, v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS planned_qty, a.cavity AS cavity, a.cycle_time AS cycle_time, a.efficiency AS efficiency FROM public.mes_scheduling_output a LEFT JOIN public.mes_scheduling b ON b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt s ON s.ma_ct = 'WOMS' AND s.status = a.status_wo JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(b.ma_dvcs, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_oee_daily.title: Hiệu suất vận hành & OEE theo máy (theo logic mesbcoee)
mes_oee_daily.notes: Chỉ số OEE tính cho máy có khai báo cycle_time và cavity; máy lắp ráp không có cycle_time trả NULL (chưa đủ căn cứ tính OEE).
mes_oee_daily.source_sql: SELECT r.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(l.line_group_code3, '') AS line_group, r.day, round(r.run_minutes::numeric, 2) AS run_minutes, round(coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0)::numeric, 2) AS stop_minutes, round(GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)::numeric, 2) AS net_minutes, round((r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS standard_minutes, r.ok_qty, r.ng_qty, round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 THEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes END)::numeric, 2) AS availability_pct, round((CASE WHEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) END)::numeric, 2) AS performance_pct, round((CASE WHEN (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 THEN r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) END)::numeric, 2) AS quality_pct, round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 AND GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN (GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes) * LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) * (r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty)) / 10000.0 END)::numeric, 2) AS oee_pct, 1::int AS line_days FROM (SELECT a.machine_code, a.create_date AS day, sum(coalesce(a.complete, 0)) AS ok_qty, sum(coalesce(a.ng, 0)) AS ng_qty, sum(CASE WHEN a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS run_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.complete, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ok_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.ng, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ng_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.skip_shot, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS skip_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.mes_scheduling_output s ON s.mes_scheduling_code = a.mes_scheduling_code AND s.product_code = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmhosokhuonsp k ON k.ma_khuon = s.mold_code AND k.ma_sp = a.product_code WHERE a.sp_chinh_yn = 1 GROUP BY a.machine_code, a.create_date) r LEFT JOIN public.mflist_line l ON l.line_code = r.machine_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_code, create_date AS day, sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date::timestamp + end_time::time - create_date::timestamp - create_time::time)) / 60.0) AS stop_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_stop_line WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= create_date AND end_date > '1900-01-01' GROUP BY machine_code, create_date) st ON st.machine_code = r.machine_code AND st.day = r.day JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(l.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_material_usage.title: Cấp và tiêu hao nguyên vật liệu sản xuất (mes_oi_material)
mes_material_usage.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.product_code AS product, coalesce(vp.ten_vt, '') AS product_name, a.material_code AS material, coalesce(NULLIF(a.material_name, ''), vm.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(NULLIF(a.dvt, ''), vm.dvt, '') AS unit, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(a.so_luong_can_cap, 0) AS required_qty, coalesce(a.so_luong, 0) AS issued_qty, coalesce(a.sl_su_dung, 0) AS used_qty, coalesce(a.sl_con_lai, 0) AS remaining_qty, coalesce(a.sl_chenh_lech, 0) AS variance_qty, a.id_material AS feed_id FROM public.mes_oi_material a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vp ON vp.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vm ON vm.ma_vt = a.material_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mold_cavity_specs.title: Liên kết Khuôn - Sản phẩm - Cavity - Chu kỳ - Tuổi thọ shot
mold_cavity_specs.notes: Bảng danh mục khuôn; không yêu cầu lọc ngày. Dùng max trên total_shots/warranty_shots/cavity để không cộng trùng qua các mã con.
mold_cavity_specs.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_khuon AS mold, coalesce(h.ten_khuon, '') AS mold_name, s.ma_sp AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(s.id_cap, '') AS cavity_group, coalesce(s.chinh_phu::text, '') AS primary_flag, coalesce(s.cavity, h.so_cavity, 0) AS cavity, coalesce(s.chu_ki, 0) AS cycle_sec, coalesce(h.tong_so_shot, 0) AS total_shots, coalesce(h.so_shot_bh, 0) AS warranty_shots, (coalesce(h.so_shot_bh, 0) - coalesce(h.tong_so_shot, 0)) AS remaining_warranty_shots, s.ln AS line_id FROM public.dmhosokhuon h JOIN public.dmhosokhuonsp s ON s.ma_khuon = h.ma_khuon LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = s.ma_sp JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(h.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

production_forecast_demand.title: Nhu cầu giao hàng PO & Dự báo FCST (snapshot mới nhất mfkhsx_po_fc)
production_forecast_demand.notes: Chỉ lấy snapshot tính toán mới nhất (max(date0)) để tránh cộng trùng giữa các ngày chạy MRP; lọc day theo ngày giao hàng (ngay_giao_hang). Giá trị demand_type trong DB là 'FC' (FCST/dự báo) và 'PO' (DO/đơn hàng). Với câu hỏi nhu cầu/FCST tương lai không nêu tháng cụ thể, lọc day từ ngày hiện tại (today) đến +365 ngày; nếu mã biến thể có hậu tố trả 0 dòng, thử lọc material bằng op='contains' theo mã gốc.
production_forecast_demand.source_sql: SELECT f.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(f.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(f.loai_du_lieu, '') AS demand_type, coalesce(f.nguon_du_lieu, '') AS data_source, coalesce(f.model, '') AS model, f.ngay_giao_hang AS day, coalesce(v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(f.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, f.id AS line_id FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc f LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = f.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = f.ma_vt CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND f.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc)

gl_account_movements.title: Phát sinh sổ cái & công nợ kế toán (ct00 / dmtk0)
gl_account_movements.notes: Chỉ gồm các dòng có phát sinh tiền khác 0. Trong CSDL ERP hiện tại, ct00 chỉ có số tiền phát sinh đến 2024-09-06 và bảng số dư đầu kỳ cdkh/cdtk đang trống (0 dòng).
gl_account_movements.source_sql: SELECT trim(coalesce(c.tk, '')) AS account, coalesce(t.ten_tk, '') AS account_name, trim(coalesce(c.tk_du, '')) AS offset_account, trim(coalesce(c.ma_kh, '')) AS partner, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS partner_name, trim(coalesce(c.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, trim(coalesce(c.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, c.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(c.ps_no, 0) AS debit_vnd, coalesce(c.ps_co, 0) AS credit_vnd, coalesce(c.ps_no_nt, 0) AS debit_orig, coalesce(c.ps_co_nt, 0) AS credit_orig, c.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ct00 c LEFT JOIN public.dmtk0 t ON t.tk = c.tk LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = c.ma_kh JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(c.ps_no, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_co, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_no_nt, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_co_nt, 0) <> 0) AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR c.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

sales_delivery_orders.title: Lệnh giao hàng bán (TO2)
sales_delivery_orders.notes: day (ngay_ct) là ngày lập lệnh TO2; delivery_date (ngay_gh) là ngày giao hàng dự kiến. Lọc theo tên KH không dấu với customer_name hoặc số PO KH với po_kh.
sales_delivery_orders.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(nullif(d.so_ct_so1, ''), '') AS so_no, coalesce(nullif(d.so_po, ''), '') AS po_kh, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.ngay_gh, h.ngay_gh) AS delivery_date, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, coalesce(d.tien2, 0) AS revenue_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt2, 0) AS revenue_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph96 h JOIN public.ct96 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'TO2' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_quotations.title: Giấy báo giá bán hàng (SQ1)
sales_quotations.notes: Lưu giá chào bán và trạng thái duyệt của báo giá gửi khách hàng.
sales_quotations.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, coalesce(d.gia2, 0) AS unit_price_vnd, coalesce(d.tien2, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt2, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph61 h JOIN public.ct61 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'SQ1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

sales_returns.title: Hàng bán bị trả lại (HDF)
sales_returns.notes: Phiếu nhập lại hàng bán bị trả về từ khách hàng (HDF).
sales_returns.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_so1, '') AS so_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS return_qty, coalesce(d.tien2, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt2, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph76 h JOIN public.ct76 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'HDF' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_return_requests.title: Phiếu yêu cầu đổi trả hàng bán (RQ1)
sales_return_requests.notes: Theo dõi phiếu đề nghị đổi/trả hàng từ khách hàng (RQ1).
sales_return_requests.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_dh, '') AS so_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS return_qty, coalesce(d.tien2, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt2, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph66 h JOIN public.ct66 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'RQ1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

supplier_quotations.title: Báo giá nhà cung cấp (BG0)
supplier_quotations.notes: Lưu báo giá chào hàng của NCC theo từng vật tư và hiệu lực ngày bắt đầu/kết thúc.
supplier_quotations.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_bd AS valid_from, d.ngay_kt AS valid_to, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, coalesce(d.gia, 0) AS unit_price_vnd, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phbgncc h JOIN public.ctbgncc d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'BG0' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_prices_current.title: Bảng giá mua nhà cung cấp hiện hành
purchase_prices_current.notes: Bảng danh mục giá mua đang có hiệu lực theo NCC và vật tư (dmgiamuact, status='1'). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
purchase_prices_current.source_sql: SELECT d.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, trim(coalesce(d.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, coalesce(v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.ngay_bd AS valid_from, d.ngay_kt AS valid_to, coalesce(d.gia, 0) AS unit_price_vnd, coalesce(d.sl_min, 0) AS moq, (coalesce(d.ma_kh, '') || '|' || coalesce(d.ma_vt, '') || '|' || coalesce(d.ngay_bd::text, '')) AS line_id FROM public.dmgiamuact d LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = d.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE d.status::text = '1'

sales_prices_current.title: Danh mục bảng giá bán tổng hợp
sales_prices_current.notes: Tổng hợp/so sánh giá bán và MOQ theo khách hàng, mã hàng, bảng giá đang hiệu lực. Nếu cần tra đúng mức giá áp dụng tại một ngày cụ thể cho 1 mã, có thể dùng thêm query_price_list.
sales_prices_current.source_sql: SELECT d.ma_bang_gia AS price_list_id, coalesce(h.ten_bang_gia, '') AS price_list_name, coalesce(d.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, trim(coalesce(d.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.ngay_bd, h.ngay_bd) AS valid_from, coalesce(d.ngay_kt, h.ngay_kt) AS valid_to, coalesce(d.gia, 0) AS unit_price_vnd, coalesce(d.gia_nt, 0) AS unit_price_orig, coalesce(d.sl_min, 0) AS moq, (coalesce(d.ma_bang_gia, '') || '|' || coalesce(d.ma_kh, '') || '|' || coalesce(d.ma_vt, '') || '|' || coalesce(d.sl_min::text, '0')) AS line_id FROM public.dmbanggiact d JOIN public.dmbanggia h ON h.ma_bang_gia = d.ma_bang_gia LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = d.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text = '1' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(h.ma_dvcs, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

planning_pending_po.title: Đơn mua hàng (PO) nhựa & linh kiện đang pending chờ giao
planning_pending_po.notes: Ảnh chụp snapshot mới nhất của PO linh kiện và PO nhựa còn pending chờ giao hàng. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày; required_date (ngay_yc) là ngày yêu cầu giao.
planning_pending_po.source_sql: SELECT p.pending_type, coalesce(p.so_ct, '') AS po_no, coalesce(p.so_ct_ycm, '') AS pr_no, coalesce(p.ma_ncc, '') AS supplier, coalesce(p.ten_ncc, '') AS supplier_name, coalesce(p.ma_vt, '') AS material, coalesce(p.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(nullif(p.trang_thai, ''), 'Chưa gán trạng thái') AS status_name, p.ngay_yc AS required_date, p.ngay_ncc_xac_nhan_giao AS confirmed_delivery_date, coalesce(p.so_luong, 0) AS pending_qty, p.row_key FROM (  SELECT 'Linh kiện'::text AS pending_type, so_ct, so_ct_ycm, ma_ncc, ten_ncc, ma_vt, ten_vt, trang_thai, ngay_yc, ngay_ncc_xac_nhan_giao, so_luong, ('LK|' || id || '|' || stt) AS row_key   FROM public.mfkhsx_po_pending_linhkien WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_po_pending_linhkien)   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Nhựa'::text AS pending_type, so_ct, so_ct_ycm, ma_ncc, ten_ncc, ma_vt, ten_vt, trang_thai, ngay_yc, ngay_ncc_xac_nhan_giao, so_luong, ('NH|' || id || '|' || stt) AS row_key   FROM public.mfkhsx_po_nhua_pending WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_po_nhua_pending)) p CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

inventory_stock_lots.title: Tồn kho hiện hành theo kho, vị trí, số lô & hạn sử dụng
inventory_stock_lots.notes: Ảnh chụp số dư tồn hiện tại trong cdvt13 (loại bỏ dòng tồn bằng 0) ghép ngày sản xuất/hạn sử dụng từ dmlo. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
inventory_stock_lots.source_sql: SELECT c.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(c.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, c.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(c.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce(v.dvt, '') AS unit, l.ngay_sx AS mfg_date, l.ngay_hhsd AS expiry_date, c.ton13 AS stock_qty, (c.ma_kho || '|' || c.ma_vt || '|' || coalesce(c.ma_lo, '') || '|' || coalesce(c.ma_vi_tri, '') || '|' || coalesce(c.so_seri_vt, '')) AS row_key FROM public.cdvt13 c LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = c.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmlo l ON l.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND l.ma_lo = c.ma_lo JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE coalesce(c.ton13, 0) <> 0 AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR c.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ','))))

warehouse_transfers.title: Phiếu xuất/nhập điều chuyển kho (PXB/PNF)
warehouse_transfers.notes: Điều chuyển kho giữa kho xuất (warehouse) và kho nhận (target_warehouse). Toàn bộ chứng từ điều chuyển ph85/ct85 mang doc_type='PXB' (bao hàm luồng xuất/nhập chuyển kho); không cần lọc thêm doc_type khi thống kê toàn bộ chuyển kho.
warehouse_transfers.source_sql: SELECT trim(coalesce(h.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce((SELECT wk.ten_kho FROM public.dmkho wk WHERE wk.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LIMIT 1), '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(nullif(d.ma_khon, ''), h.ma_khon, '') AS target_warehouse, coalesce((SELECT wn.ten_kho FROM public.dmkho wn WHERE wn.ma_kho = coalesce(nullif(d.ma_khon, ''), h.ma_khon) LIMIT 1), '') AS target_warehouse_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce((SELECT v.ten_vt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS material_name, coalesce((SELECT tt.statusname FROM public.sys_dmtt tt WHERE tt.ma_ct = h.ma_ct AND tt.status::text = h.status::text LIMIT 1), h.status::text, '') AS status_name, coalesce(nullif(d.dvt, ''), (SELECT v.dvt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS transfer_qty, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph85 h JOIN public.ct85 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')) OR coalesce(d.ma_khon, h.ma_khon) = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

warehouse_internal_issues.title: Phiếu xuất kho nội bộ / xuất sản xuất (PXA)
warehouse_internal_issues.notes: Phiếu xuất kho nội bộ PXA gắn bộ phận (department), dây chuyền và lệnh sản xuất (PD1). PXA là loại chứng từ (doc_type='PXA'), KHÔNG phải mã bộ phận.
warehouse_internal_issues.source_sql: SELECT trim(coalesce(h.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(nullif(d.ma_bp, ''), h.ma_bp, '') AS department, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.so_ct_pd1, '') AS work_order, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS out_qty, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph84 h JOIN public.ct84 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PXA' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

warehouse_internal_receipts.title: Phiếu nhập kho nội bộ / nhập thành phẩm (PND)
warehouse_internal_receipts.notes: Phiếu nhập kho nội bộ PND gắn kho nhận (warehouse), bộ phận (department) và lệnh sản xuất. PND là tên loại chứng từ (doc_type='PND'), KHÔNG truyền 'PND' vào department hay warehouse.
warehouse_internal_receipts.source_sql: SELECT trim(coalesce(h.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.ma_bp, '') AS department, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.so_ct_pd1, '') AS work_order, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS in_qty, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph74 h JOIN public.ct74 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PND' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

warehouse_requests.title: Phiếu yêu cầu nhập / xuất kho (DNV / DXV)
warehouse_requests.notes: Gộp phiếu yêu cầu nhập kho (DNV) và phiếu yêu cầu xuất NVL/kho (DXV) theo bộ phận, nhân viên và lệnh sản xuất.
warehouse_requests.source_sql: SELECT q.request_type, q.so_ct AS doc_no, q.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(q.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(q.ma_nv, '') AS employee_code, coalesce(k.ten_kh, q.ma_nv, '') AS employee_name, q.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(q.so_ct_pd1, '') AS work_order, coalesce(tt.statusname, q.status, '') AS status_name, coalesce(q.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, q.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(q.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, q.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM (  SELECT 'DNV'::text AS request_type, h.ma_dvcs, h.so_ct, d.ma_kho, h.ma_bp, h.ma_nv, d.ma_vt, d.so_ct_pd1, h.status::text AS status, 'DNV'::text AS ma_ct, d.dvt, h.ngay_ct, d.so_luong, h.stt_rec   FROM public.phdnv h JOIN public.ctdnv d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15')   UNION ALL   SELECT 'DXV'::text AS request_type, h.ma_dvcs, h.so_ct, d.ma_kho, h.ma_bp, h.ma_nv, d.ma_vt, d.so_ct_pd1, h.status::text AS status, 'DXV'::text AS ma_ct, d.dvt, h.ngay_ct, d.so_luong, h.stt_rec   FROM public.phdxnvl h JOIN public.ctdxnvl d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15')) q LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = q.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = q.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = q.ma_nv LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = q.ma_ct AND tt.status::text = q.status JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (q.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR q.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

planning_stock_snapshot.title: Ảnh chụp tồn kho KHSX (Nhựa, Linh kiện, Kho OK, Kho NG)
planning_stock_snapshot.notes: Tổng hợp snapshot tồn kho mới nhất phục vụ kế hoạch sản xuất (lấy max(date0) cho từng bảng mfkhsx_ton_*). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
planning_stock_snapshot.source_sql: SELECT s.stock_type, coalesce(s.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(s.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, coalesce(s.ma_vt, '') AS material, coalesce(s.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(s.model, '') AS model, coalesce(s.ten_ncc, '') AS supplier_name, coalesce(s.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, s.date0 AS snapshot_date, coalesce(s.so_luong, 0) AS stock_qty, s.row_key FROM (  SELECT 'Nhựa'::text AS stock_type, ma_kho, ''::text AS ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten_vt, model, ten_ncc, ma_lo, date0, so_luong, ('NH|' || id || '|' || stt) AS row_key   FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_nhua WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_nhua)   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Linh kiện'::text, ma_kho, ''::text, ma_vt, ten_vt, model, ten_ncc, ''::text, date0, so_luong, ('LK|' || id || '|' || stt)   FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_linhkien WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_linhkien)   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Kho OK'::text, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten_vt, model, ''::text, ''::text, date0, so_luong, ('OK|' || id || '|' || stt)   FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_kho_ok WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_kho_ok)   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Kho NG'::text, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten_vt, model, ''::text, ''::text, date0, so_luong, ('NG|' || id || '|' || stt)   FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_kho_ng WHERE date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_ton_kho_ng)) s LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = s.ma_kho JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR coalesce(s.ma_kho, '') = '' OR s.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))

production_orders.title: Lệnh sản xuất ERP (PD1)
production_orders.notes: Lệnh sản xuất ERP gắn đơn hàng bán (so_no), khách hàng, sản phẩm, bộ phận và ngày hoàn thành.
production_orders.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(nullif(d.so_ct_so1, ''), h.so_ct_so1, '') AS so_no, coalesce(nullif(d.ma_kh, ''), h.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(h.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(h.ma_phan_xuong, '') AS work_center, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.ngay_ht, h.ngay_ht) AS delivery_date, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS planned_qty, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phlsx h JOIN public.ctlsx d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = coalesce(nullif(d.ma_kh, ''), h.ma_kh) LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PD1' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

bom_materials.title: Định mức cấu trúc sản phẩm BOM (xuôi & ngược)
bom_materials.notes: Mối quan hệ BOM đang hiệu lực (mfbom status='1'): cho phép tra xuôi từ sản phẩm sang NVL hoặc tra ngược 1 NVL dùng cho các sản phẩm nào. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
bom_materials.source_sql: SELECT h.bom_code, coalesce(h.bom_version, '') AS bom_version, h.product_code AS product, coalesce(vp.ten_vt, '') AS product_name, d.material_code AS material, coalesce(vm.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.operation_code, '') AS step, coalesce(d.uom, vm.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(h.ma_ecn, '') AS ecn_no, coalesce(d.quantity, 0) AS bom_qty, coalesce(d.loss_ratio_allowed, 0) AS loss_pct, (h.bom_code || '|' || coalesce(h.bom_version, '') || '|' || d.material_code || '|' || coalesce(d.ln::text, '0')) AS row_key FROM public.mfbom h JOIN public.mfbom_material d ON d.bom_code = h.bom_code AND coalesce(d.bom_version, '') = coalesce(h.bom_version, '') LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vp ON vp.ma_vt = h.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vm ON vm.ma_vt = d.material_code JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text = '1'

ecn_and_bom_changes.title: Thay đổi kỹ thuật ECN & lịch sử cập nhật BOM
ecn_and_bom_changes.notes: Gộp phiếu ECN kỹ thuật (phecn/ctecn) và lịch sử thay đổi BOM (history_bom_change). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
ecn_and_bom_changes.source_sql: SELECT 'ECN'::text AS change_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(h.so_ecn_kh, '') AS ecn_no, coalesce(h.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(d.ma_sp, '') AS product, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS product_name, coalesce(d.ma_khuon, '') AS mold, coalesce(d.model, '') AS model, ''::text AS bom_code, ''::text AS bom_version, ''::text AS employee_name, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, h.ngay_ct AS day, ('ECN|' || h.stt_rec || '|' || coalesce(d.ln::text, '0')) AS row_key FROM public.phecn h JOIN public.ctecn d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_sp LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'ECN' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ','))) UNION ALL SELECT ('BOM: ' || coalesce(b.type_change::text, 'Cập nhật'))::text, coalesce(b.bom_code, ''), ''::text, ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(b.product_code, ''), coalesce(v.ten_vt, ''), ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(b.bom_code, ''), coalesce(b.ver, ''), coalesce(b.user_change, ''), coalesce(b.content_change, ''), b.date_change, ('BOM|' || coalesce(b.product_code, '') || '|' || coalesce(b.bom_code, '') || '|' || coalesce(b.date_change::text, '') || '|' || coalesce(b.time_change::text, '')) FROM public.history_bom_change b LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = b.product_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_setup_and_mold_ops.title: Setup máy & vận hành lên/xuống khuôn MES
mes_setup_and_mold_ops.notes: Gộp dữ liệu setup máy (mes_oi_setup_may) và lên/xuống khuôn (mes_oi_van_hanh_khuon). setup_minutes làm tròn >= 0 từ thời điểm bắt đầu tới kết thúc.
mes_setup_and_mold_ops.source_sql: SELECT o.op_type, o.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(o.mold_code, '') AS mold, coalesce(m.ten_khuon, '') AS mold_name, coalesce(o.material_code, '') AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(o.employee_code, '') AS employee_code, coalesce(o.station_code, '') AS station, coalesce(o.mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code, coalesce(o.error_code, '') AS defect_code, coalesce(o.status_name, '') AS status_name, o.day, coalesce(o.setup_minutes, 0) AS setup_minutes, coalesce(o.skip_shots, 0) AS skip_shots, o.row_key FROM (  SELECT 'Setup máy'::text AS op_type, machine_code, ma_khuon AS mold_code, ma_sp AS material_code, employee_code, station_code, mes_scheduling_code, error_code, status::text AS status_name, create_date AS day,   CASE WHEN end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND create_date IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL THEN round(GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((end_date::timestamp + end_time::time) - (create_date::timestamp + create_time::time))) / 60.0, 0)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS setup_minutes,   coalesce(number_shot, 0) AS skip_shots, ('SU|' || id_setup) AS row_key FROM public.mes_oi_setup_may   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Vận hành khuôn'::text, machine_code, coalesce(nullif(ma_khuon_len, ''), ma_khuon_xuong, ''), ''::text, employee_code, station_code, mes_scheduling_code, error_code, status::text, create_date,   CASE WHEN end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND create_date IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL THEN round(GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((end_date::timestamp + end_time::time) - (create_date::timestamp + create_time::time))) / 60.0, 0)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END,   0::numeric, ('VH|' || id_vh) FROM public.mes_oi_van_hanh_khuon) o LEFT JOIN public.dmhosokhuon m ON m.ma_khuon = o.mold_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = o.material_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_operators_output.title: Nhân sự đứng máy & sản lượng thực hiện MES
mes_operators_output.notes: Ghi nhận công nhân vận hành đứng máy và sản lượng thực hiện (sl_th) theo phiên.
mes_operators_output.source_sql: SELECT coalesce(a.staff_code, '') AS employee_code, coalesce(a.staff_name, '') AS employee_name, coalesce(a.ma_sp, '') AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.step_code, '') AS step, coalesce(a.mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code, coalesce(a.ten_ly_do, '') AS reason_text, a.date0 AS day, coalesce(a.sl_th, 0) AS actual_qty, (coalesce(a.id_oi, '') || '|' || coalesce(a.ln::text, '0') || '|' || coalesce(a.stt::text, '0')) AS row_key FROM public.mes_oi_nv_dung_may a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.ma_sp JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(a.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_carton_packing.title: Đóng thùng thành phẩm trên MES
mes_carton_packing.notes: Ghi nhận chi tiết đóng thùng (tem thùng, mã thùng, số lượng sản phẩm, lô) tại xưởng.
mes_carton_packing.source_sql: SELECT coalesce(a.station_code, '') AS station, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, coalesce(a.mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code, coalesce(a.product_code, '') AS material, coalesce(a.product_name, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce(a.ma_thung, '') AS box_code, coalesce(a.status::text, '') AS status_name, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS packing_qty, (coalesce(a.id_thung::text, '0') || '|' || coalesce(a.serial_tem_thung, '') || '|' || coalesce(a.stt::text, '0') || '|' || coalesce(a.ln::text, '0')) AS row_key FROM public.mes_oi_dong_thung a CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_shot_rejections.title: Thống kê bỏ shot & nhựa xả máy (MES)
mes_shot_rejections.notes: Ghi nhận số lượng shot bỏ và sản phẩm quy đổi trong quá trình ép/xả máy.
mes_shot_rejections.source_sql: SELECT coalesce(a.machine_code, '') AS machine, coalesce(a.station_code, '') AS station, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, coalesce(a.mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code, coalesce(a.product_code, '') AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.staff_code, '') AS employee_code, coalesce(a.error_code, '') AS defect_code, a.date0 AS day, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS skip_shots, coalesce(a.quantity_product, 0) AS skip_qty, (coalesce(a.id_oi, '') || '|' || coalesce(a.machine_code, '') || '|' || coalesce(a.time0::text, '')) AS row_key FROM public.mes_oi_bo_shot a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_scheduling_plan.title: Lịch điều độ sản xuất theo máy (WO1 / Scheduling)
mes_scheduling_plan.notes: day là ngày bắt đầu dự kiến trên lịch điều độ (start_date); delivery_date là hạn giao đơn hàng. Join mes_scheduling -> mes_scheduling_output qua stt_rec.
mes_scheduling_plan.source_sql: SELECT d.mes_scheduling_code AS schedule_code, coalesce(d.machine_code, '') AS machine, coalesce(d.production_order, '') AS work_order, coalesce(d.sale_order, '') AS so_no, d.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.mold_code, '') AS mold, coalesce(d.step_code, '') AS step, coalesce(d.work_center_code, h.work_center_code, '') AS work_center, coalesce(d.uom, v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, d.start_date AS day, d.delivery_date AS delivery_date, coalesce(d.quantity, 0) AS schedule_qty, coalesce(d.efficiency, 0) AS efficiency, coalesce(d.cycle_time, 0) AS cycle_sec FROM public.mes_scheduling h JOIN public.mes_scheduling_output d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.product_code JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(h.ma_dvcs, d.factory_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

qc_pqc_lines.title: Kiểm tra chất lượng công đoạn sản xuất (PQC / IPQC)
qc_pqc_lines.notes: Phiếu kiểm tra chất lượng trong công đoạn sản xuất (phpqc). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
qc_pqc_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(h.ma_sp, h.ma_vt, '') AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(h.ma_may, '') AS machine, coalesce(h.ma_day_chuyen, '') AS line_group, coalesce(h.ma_khuon, '') AS mold, coalesce(h.so_ct_pd1, '') AS work_order, coalesce(h.ket_qua::text, '') AS qc_result, coalesce(tt.statusname, h.status::text, '') AS status_name, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(h.so_luong, 0) AS lot_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ok, 0) AS ok_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ng, 0) AS ng_qty, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phpqc h LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = coalesce(h.ma_sp, h.ma_vt) LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt tt ON tt.ma_ct = 'PQC' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mold_incident_status.title: Tình trạng khuôn, sự cố & lịch sử bảo dưỡng khuôn
mold_incident_status.notes: Ảnh chụp snapshot mới nhất thông tin trạng thái khuôn, loại sự cố (Sửa chữa/Bảo dưỡng), kho/vị trí và ngày bảo dưỡng cuối. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
mold_incident_status.source_sql: SELECT t.ma_khuon AS mold, coalesce(nullif(t.ten_khuon, ''), h.ten_khuon, '') AS mold_name, coalesce(t.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(t.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(t.loai_su_co, '') AS incident_type, coalesce(t.chi_tiet_su_co_khuon, t.tinh_trang_khuon, '') AS incident_detail, coalesce(t.trang_thai, '') AS status_name, coalesce(t.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(t.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, t.ngay_bd_cuoi AS last_maint_date, coalesce(t.total_shot, h.tong_so_shot, 0) AS total_shots, coalesce(t.shot_bao_hanh, h.so_shot_bh, 0) AS warranty_shots FROM public.mfkhsx_thongtin_khuon t LEFT JOIN public.dmhosokhuon h ON h.ma_khuon = t.ma_khuon JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE t.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_thongtin_khuon) AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(h.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_receipt_requests.title: Phiếu yêu cầu nhập hàng mua (YCN)
purchase_receipt_requests.notes: day (ngay_ct) là ngày lập phiếu YCN; requested_date là ngày đề nghị nhập (ngay_de_nghi_nh); promise_date là ngày hứa nhập (ngay_hua_nh).
purchase_receipt_requests.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_po1, '') AS po_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(nullif(k.ten_kh, ''), h.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(h.ma_bp, d.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce((SELECT tt.statusname FROM public.sys_dmtt tt WHERE tt.ma_ct = 'YCN' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text LIMIT 1), h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_de_nghi_nh AS requested_date, d.ngay_hua_nh AS promise_date, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phycn h JOIN public.ctycn d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho) JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho, '') = '' OR coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho) = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

purchase_returns.title: Phiếu xuất trả lại nhà cung cấp (PXC)
purchase_returns.notes: Chứng từ xuất kho trả lại hàng mua cho nhà cung cấp (ph86/ct86). Tập dữ liệu ít dòng, không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
purchase_returns.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_rq2, '') AS rq_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(nullif(k.ten_kh, ''), h.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce((SELECT tt.statusname FROM public.sys_dmtt tt WHERE tt.ma_ct = 'PXC' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text LIMIT 1), h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS return_qty, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, coalesce(d.tien_nt, 0) AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph86 h JOIN public.ct86 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = coalesce(d.ma_kho, h.ma_kho) JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_return_requests.title: Phiếu yêu cầu đổi / trả hàng mua (RQ2)
purchase_return_requests.notes: Phiếu đề nghị đổi trả hàng cho nhà cung cấp (ph67/ct67), ghi nhận lý do lỗi và số lượng duyệt trả. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
purchase_return_requests.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_pr1, '') AS pr1_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(nullif(k.ten_kh, ''), h.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.ten_loi, '') AS reason_name, coalesce((SELECT tt.statusname FROM public.sys_dmtt tt WHERE tt.ma_ct = 'RQ2' AND tt.status::text = h.status::text LIMIT 1), h.status::text, '') AS status_name, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_tra_hang AS delivery_date, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS return_qty, coalesce(d.tien, 0) AS amount_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph67 h JOIN public.ct67 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

resin_mixing_operations.title: Lệnh sản xuất & quản lý công đoạn trộn nhựa (PD2 / QLT)
resin_mixing_operations.notes: Gộp Lệnh sản xuất công đoạn trộn (PD2: phlsxtron/ctlsxtron) và Phiếu quản lý trộn NVL (QLT: phqlt/ctqltnvl). Tập nhỏ, không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
resin_mixing_operations.source_sql: SELECT doc_type, doc_no, department, material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, product_code, lot_no, warehouse, shift, status_name, unit, day, mixing_ratio, quantity, packed_qty, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'PD2'::text AS doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(h.ma_bp, h.ma_phan_xuong, '') AS department,          d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(d.ma_vt_chinh, '') AS product_code, ''::text AS lot_no,          coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(d.ca_sx, '') AS shift,          coalesce(h.status::text, '') AS status_name, coalesce(nullif(d.dvt, ''), 'KG') AS unit,          h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.ty_le_tron, 0) AS mixing_ratio, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity,          0::numeric AS packed_qty, (h.stt_rec || '|PD2|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key, h.ma_dvcs AS branch   FROM public.phlsxtron h JOIN public.ctlsxtron d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15'   UNION ALL   SELECT 'QLT'::text AS doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(h.nv_thuc_hien, '') AS department,          d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(h.ma_vt, '') AS product_code, coalesce(d.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no,          coalesce(h.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, ''::text AS shift,          coalesce(h.status::text, '') AS status_name, 'KG'::text AS unit,          h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(h.ty_le_tron, 0) AS mixing_ratio, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity,          coalesce(d.sl_da_dong_goi, 0) AS packed_qty, (h.stt_rec || '|QLT|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key, h.ma_dvcs AS branch   FROM public.phqlt h JOIN public.ctqltnvl d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15') m LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = m.material JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR m.branch = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_delivery_schedules.title: Kế hoạch nhận hàng & lịch hẹn giao PO từ NCC (ctkhnh)
purchase_delivery_schedules.notes: day là ngày PO (ngay_ct); requested_date là ngày đề nghị nhận hàng; promise_date là ngày NCC hứa giao (ngay_hua_nh). Với lịch hẹn nhận hàng tương lai, lọc theo promise_date hoặc requested_date.
purchase_delivery_schedules.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS po_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_pr0, '') AS pr_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(nullif(k.ten_kh, ''), h.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_bp, '') AS department, d.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_de_nghi_nh AS requested_date, d.ngay_hua_nh AS promise_date, coalesce(nullif(d.dvt_yc, ''), v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(d.so_luong_yc, 0) AS needed_qty, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, coalesce(d.so_luong1, 0) AS actual_qty, (h.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ph94 h JOIN public.ctkhnh d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

warehouse_stock_detail_ledger.title: Sổ chi tiết nhập xuất kho theo vị trí, lô & mã NX (ct70bsp)
warehouse_stock_detail_ledger.notes: Bảng phát sinh chi tiết kho theo vị trí (location), số lô (lot_no), mã nhập xuất (txn_code) và đối tác (ct70bsp).
warehouse_stock_detail_ledger.source_sql: SELECT c.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce((SELECT w.ten_kho FROM public.dmkho w WHERE w.ma_kho = c.ma_kho LIMIT 1), '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(c.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, coalesce(c.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce(c.ma_nx, '') AS txn_code, coalesce(c.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce((SELECT k.ten_kh FROM public.dmkh k WHERE k.ma_kh = c.ma_kh LIMIT 1), '') AS customer_name, c.ma_vt AS material, coalesce((SELECT v.ten_vt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS material_name, coalesce(nullif(c.dvt, ''), (SELECT v.dvt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS unit, trim(coalesce(c.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, c.so_ct AS doc_no, c.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(c.sl_nhap, 0) AS in_qty, coalesce(c.sl_xuat, 0) AS out_qty, coalesce(c.tien_nhap, 0) AS in_amount_vnd, coalesce(c.tien_xuat, 0) AS out_amount_vnd, (c.stt_rec || '|' || c.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ct70bsp c JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR c.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))

warehouse_pallet_packing.title: Quản lý đóng Pallet & chi tiết thùng trên Pallet
warehouse_pallet_packing.notes: Liên kết pallet -> palletct theo id_pallet; day là ngày tạo pallet (date0), mfg_date là ngay_sx, expiry_date là ngay_hsd.
warehouse_pallet_packing.source_sql: SELECT p.id_pallet AS pallet_id, coalesce(p.serial_tem, '') AS pallet_serial, coalesce(c.serial_carton, '') AS carton_serial, coalesce(c.ma_vt, '') AS material, coalesce((SELECT v.ten_vt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS material_name, coalesce(nullif(c.ma_lo, ''), p.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce(nullif(c.dvt, ''), (SELECT v.dvt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LIMIT 1), 'PCS') AS unit, p.date0 AS day, p.ngay_sx AS mfg_date, p.ngay_hsd AS expiry_date, coalesce(c.so_luong, 0) AS packing_qty, (p.id_pallet || '|' || c.id_carton) AS row_key FROM public.pallet p JOIN public.palletct c ON c.id_pallet = p.id_pallet CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND coalesce(p.status::text, '') <> '15'

sales_delivery_lots.title: Chỉ thị lô xuất & vị trí kho trên Lệnh giao hàng (TO2 / ct96lo)
sales_delivery_lots.notes: Chi tiết chỉ định số lô (lot_no), lô NCC và vị trí kho (location) gắn Lệnh giao hàng TO2 (ph96/ct96lo).
sales_delivery_lots.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce((SELECT k.ten_kh FROM public.dmkh k WHERE k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LIMIT 1), h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce((SELECT v.ten_vt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce((SELECT w.ten_kho FROM public.dmkho w WHERE w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LIMIT 1), '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, coalesce(d.ma_lo, '') AS lot_no, coalesce(nullif(d.dvt, ''), (SELECT v.dvt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), 'PCS') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, (h.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln_item::text || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ph96 h JOIN public.ct96lo d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_delivery_serials.title: Chi tiết tem serial xuất kho bán hàng (HDA / ct81tem)
sales_delivery_serials.notes: Ghi nhận chi tiết serial tem gắn từng phiếu xuất kho bán hàng HDA (ph81/ct81tem) và số lệnh giao hàng TO2.
sales_delivery_serials.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.so_ct_to2, '') AS order_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce((SELECT k.ten_kh FROM public.dmkh k WHERE k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LIMIT 1), h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce((SELECT v.ten_vt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce((SELECT w.ten_kho FROM public.dmkho w WHERE w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho LIMIT 1), '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, coalesce(d.serial_tem, '') AS serial_tem, coalesce((SELECT v.dvt FROM public.dmvt v WHERE v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LIMIT 1), 'PCS') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(d.so_luong, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(d.so_luong)::numeric ELSE 0::numeric END AS quantity, (h.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ph81 h JOIN public.ct81tem d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_delivery_tools.title: Công cụ dụng cụ, khay & pallet xuất kèm giao hàng (ct81ccdc)
sales_delivery_tools.notes: Ghi nhận số lượng CCDC/khay/pallet luân chuyển xuất kèm phiếu giao hàng bán HDA (ph81/ct81ccdc).
sales_delivery_tools.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(nullif(k.ten_kh, ''), h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, (h.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ph81 h JOIN public.ct81ccdc d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = d.ma_kho JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_quotation_costings.title: Chiết tính giá thành & cấu thành chi phí báo giá (SQ1 / ct61tg)
sales_quotation_costings.notes: Chứa thông số chiết tính giá thành trên báo giá SQ1: cavity, cycle_time, part_weight, chi phí NVL, khuôn, tổng giá thành và đơn giá USD/VND.
sales_quotation_costings.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(nullif(d.ma_kh, ''), h.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, h.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(nullif(d.ten_vt, ''), v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.model, '') AS model, coalesce(d.machine, '') AS machine, d.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.cavity, 0) AS cavity, coalesce(d.cycle_time, 0) AS cycle_time, coalesce(d.part_weight, 0) AS part_weight, coalesce(d.t_cost_vt, 0) AS material_cost, coalesce(d.t_cost_khuon, 0) AS mold_cost, coalesce(d.total_cost, 0) AS cost_vnd, coalesce(d.unit_price_usd, 0) AS unit_price_usd, coalesce(d.unit_price_vnd, 0) AS unit_price_vnd, (h.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key FROM public.ph61 h JOIN public.ct61tg d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = coalesce(nullif(d.ma_kh, ''), h.ma_kh) LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

planning_btp_forecast.title: Nhu cầu PO & Dự báo FCST bán thành phẩm (BTP - mfkhsx_po_fc_btp)
planning_btp_forecast.notes: Chỉ lấy snapshot mới nhất max(date0) của mfkhsx_po_fc_btp; hỗ trợ công đoạn (step_code) và demand_type ('FC'=FCST, 'PO'=DO).
planning_btp_forecast.source_sql: SELECT f.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(f.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(f.ma_cong_doan, '') AS step_code, coalesce(f.loai_du_lieu, '') AS demand_type, coalesce(f.nguon_du_lieu, '') AS data_source, coalesce(f.model, '') AS model, f.ngay_giao_hang AS day, coalesce(v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(f.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, f.id AS line_id FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc_btp f LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = f.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = f.ma_vt CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND f.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc_btp)

planning_customer_forecast_headers.title: Hồ sơ đợt Forecast khách hàng gốc (mfdmfc)
planning_customer_forecast_headers.notes: Bảng tổng hợp các đợt Forecast đầu vào của khách hàng (mfdmfc), theo dõi ma_fc, kỳ hiệu lực (ngay_ct1..ngay_ct2) và tổng sản lượng đợt. Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
planning_customer_forecast_headers.source_sql: SELECT m.ma_fc AS fc_code, coalesce(m.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(m.kieu_fc::text, '') AS fc_type, coalesce(m.period_type, '') AS period_type, coalesce(m.status::text, '') AS status_name, m.ngay_ct1 AS day, m.ngay_ct2 AS valid_to, coalesce(m.t_so_luong, 0) AS quantity FROM public.mfdmfc m LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = m.ma_kh JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE coalesce(m.status::text, '') <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR m.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

planning_material_leadtime_moq.title: Thông số Leadtime, MOQ & tái sinh Nhựa / Linh kiện KHSX
planning_material_leadtime_moq.notes: Ảnh chụp mới nhất (max date0) bảng tham số KHSX cho Nhựa (mfkhsx_nhua) và Linh kiện (mfkhsx_linh_kien). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.
planning_material_leadtime_moq.source_sql: SELECT item_type, material, material_name, supplier, supplier_short, leadtime, leadtime_kfc, moq, regen_ratio, day, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'Nhựa'::text AS item_type, n.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(n.ten_vt, '') AS material_name,          coalesce(n.ma_ncc, '') AS supplier, coalesce(n.ten_viet_tat, '') AS supplier_short,          coalesce(n.leadtime, 0) AS leadtime, coalesce(n.leadtime_kfc, 0) AS leadtime_kfc,          coalesce(n.moq, 0) AS moq, coalesce(n.ty_le_tai_sinh, 0) AS regen_ratio,          n.date0 AS day, ('NH|' || n.id || '|' || n.stt::text) AS row_key   FROM public.mfkhsx_nhua n WHERE n.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_nhua)   UNION ALL   SELECT 'Linh kiện'::text AS item_type, l.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(l.ten_vt, '') AS material_name,          coalesce(l.ma_ncc, '') AS supplier, coalesce(l.ten_viet_tat, '') AS supplier_short,          coalesce(l.leadtime, 0) AS leadtime, coalesce(l.leadtime_kfc, 0) AS leadtime_kfc,          coalesce(l.moq, 0) AS moq, 0::numeric AS regen_ratio,          l.date0 AS day, ('LK|' || l.id || '|' || l.stt::text) AS row_key   FROM public.mfkhsx_linh_kien l WHERE l.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_linh_kien)) p CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

SELECT 'Tồn tại máy'::text AS stock_type, coalesce(machine_code, '') AS machine, coalesce(ma_vi_tri, '') AS location, ''::text AS warehouse, ''::text AS model,          ma_vt AS material, planning_bom_and_alternatives.title: Định mức BOM KHSX, gate/runner & vật tư thay thế
planning_bom_and_alternatives.notes: Tổng hợp BOM chạy KHSX (mfkhsx_bom, bom_vat_tu_phu, bom_nhua_tron) và danh mục vật tư/nhựa thay thế (mfbom_material_replace, mfkhsx_nhua_thay_the). Không bắt buộc lọc ngày.

''), p.ma_vt, coalesce(p.ten_vt, ''), ''::text,          coalesce(p.bom_version, ''), ''::text, coalesce(p.so_luong_dm, 0), 0::numeric, 0::numeric, 0::numeric, ('VP|' || p.id || '|' || p.stt::text) coalesce(n.ma_vt_thay_the, ''),          ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(n.so_luong, 0), coalesce(n.sl_gate_runner, 0), 0::numeric, 0::numeric, ('NT|' || n.id || '|' || n.stt::text)   FROM
