production_order_materials_and_steps.title: Định mức NVL & quy trình công đoạn theo Lệnh SX (ctlsxvt / ctlsxqt)
production_order_materials_and_steps.notes: Chi tiết vật tư cấp (ctlsxvt) và công đoạn sản xuất/nguồn lực (ctlsxqt) trên Lệnh sản xuất ERP (PD1).
production_order_materials_and_steps.source_sql: SELECT entry_type, doc_no, product_code, material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, step_code, department, warehouse, unit, day, bom_qty, planned_qty, loss_pct, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'NVL_LSX'::text AS entry_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, coalesce(d.ma_sp, '') AS product_code,          d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(d.ma_cong_doan, '') AS step_code, coalesce(h.ma_bp, '') AS department,          coalesce(d.ma_kho, '') AS warehouse, coalesce(d.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, h.ngay_ct AS day,          coalesce(d.so_luong_dm, 0) AS bom_qty, coalesce(d.so_luong, 0) AS planned_qty, coalesce(d.ty_le_hao_hut, 0) AS loss_pct,          (h.stt_rec || '|VT|' || d.ma_sp || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key, h.ma_dvcs AS branch   FROM public.phlsx h JOIN public.ctlsxvt d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15'   UNION ALL   SELECT 'CONG_DOAN_LSX'::text, h.so_ct, coalesce(q.ma_sp, ''), coalesce(q.ma_sp, ''), coalesce(q.ma_cong_doan, ''),          coalesce(q.ma_bp, h.ma_bp, ''), ''::text, ''::text, h.ngay_ct, 0::numeric, coalesce(q.ty_le_ht, 0), 0::numeric,          (h.stt_rec || '|QT|' || q.ma_cong_doan || '|' || q.ln::text), h.ma_dvcs   FROM public.phlsx h JOIN public.ctlsxqt q ON q.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15') p LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = p.material JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR p.branch = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_preproduction_prep.title: Chuẩn bị sản xuất (CBSX) & cấp chuẩn bị NVL MES
mes_preproduction_prep.notes: Gộp phiếu chuẩn bị sản xuất (new_oi_cbsx) và cấp NVL chuẩn bị trước ca (mes_oi_material_prepare).
mes_preproduction_prep.source_sql: SELECT event_type, schedule_code, work_order, station, machine, product_code, material, lot_no, status_name, day, prepare_qty, needed_qty, feed_round, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'CBSX'::text AS event_type, coalesce(c.mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code, ''::text AS work_order,          ''::text AS station, coalesce(c.line_code, '') AS machine, ''::text AS product_code, ''::text AS material, ''::text AS lot_no,          coalesce(c.status::text, '') AS status_name, c.date0 AS day, 0::numeric AS prepare_qty, 0::numeric AS needed_qty,          coalesce(c.chuyen_buoc_yn, 0)::numeric AS feed_round, ('CB|' || c.id_cbsx) AS row_key   FROM public.new_oi_cbsx c   UNION ALL   SELECT 'CAP_CHUAN_BI_NVL'::text, coalesce(m.mes_scheduling_code, ''), coalesce(m.production_order, ''),          coalesce(m.station_code, ''), coalesce(m.machine_code, ''), coalesce(m.product_code, ''), coalesce(m.material_code, ''), coalesce(m.ma_lo, ''),          coalesce(m.status::text, ''), m.create_date, coalesce(m.so_luong, 0), coalesce(m.so_luong_can_cap, 0),          coalesce(m.lan_cap, 0)::numeric, ('MP|' || m.id_material)   FROM public.mes_oi_material_prepare m) p CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_machine_logs_and_cavity.title: Nhật ký đổi cavity, tắt đèn tháp & tạm dừng setup/khuôn MES
mes_machine_logs_and_cavity.notes: Gộp thay đổi cavity (mes_oi_change_cativity), tắt đèn tháp (towerlightoff), tạm dừng setup (setup_may_pause), tạm dừng vận hành khuôn (van_hanh_khuon_pause) và trạng thái máy.
mes_machine_logs_and_cavity.source_sql: SELECT event_type, machine, station, mold, material, defect_code, employee_code, day, cavity, cycle_sec, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'DOI_CAVITY'::text AS event_type, ''::text AS machine, ''::text AS station, coalesce(ma_khuon, '') AS mold,          coalesce(ma_sp, '') AS material, ''::text AS defect_code, ''::text AS employee_code, date0 AS day,          coalesce(cavity, 0) AS cavity, coalesce(chu_ky, 0) AS cycle_sec,          ('DC|' || id_oi || '|' || id_change_cavity || '|' || ma_khuon || '|' || ma_sp || '|' || date0::text || '|' || time0::text) AS row_key   FROM public.mes_oi_change_cativity   UNION ALL   SELECT 'TAT_DEN_THAP'::text, coalesce(machine_code, ''), ''::text, ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(ghi_chu, ''), coalesce(ma_nv, ''), date0, 0::numeric, 0::numeric,          ('TL|' || id_oi || '|' || date0::text || '|' || time0::text)   FROM public.mes_oi_towerlightoff   UNION ALL   SELECT 'TAM_DUNG_SETUP'::text, coalesce(machine_code, ''), coalesce(station_code, ''), coalesce(ma_khuon, ''), coalesce(ma_sp, ''), coalesce(error_code, ''), coalesce(employee_code, ''), create_date, 0::numeric, coalesce(chu_ky_tt, 0),          ('SP|' || id_pause)   FROM public.mes_oi_setup_may_pause   UNION ALL   SELECT 'TAM_DUNG_KHUON'::text, coalesce(machine_code, ''), coalesce(station_code, ''), ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(error_code, ''), coalesce(ma_nv_xu_ly, ''), create_date, 0::numeric, 0::numeric,          ('KP|' || id_pause)   FROM public.mes_oi_van_hanh_khuon_pause   UNION ALL   SELECT 'TRANG_THAI_MAY'::text, coalesce(machine_code, ''), coalesce(station_code, ''), coalesce(mold_code, ''), ''::text, coalesce(error_code, ''), coalesce(employee_code, ''), create_date, 0::numeric, 0::numeric,          ('MC|' || id)   FROM public.mes_oi_machine WHERE create_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE + 1) l CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mes_material_ng_and_adjustments.title: NG nguyên vật liệu, bù sản lượng & bàn giao công đoạn MES
mes_material_ng_and_adjustments.notes: Gộp NG nguyên vật liệu (mes_oi_ng_materrial), bù/điều chỉnh sản lượng (mes_oi_add_quantity), bàn giao inbound (mes_oi_inbound) và đối soát thu hồi/chênh lệch NVL (mes_oi_material_history).
mes_material_ng_and_adjustments.source_sql: SELECT event_type, machine, station, work_order, schedule_code, material, defect_code, step_code, day, ng_qty, add_qty, inbound_qty, variance_qty, row_key FROM (  SELECT 'NG_NVL'::text AS event_type, coalesce(machine_code, '') AS machine, coalesce(station_code, '') AS station,          coalesce(production_order, '') AS work_order, coalesce(mes_scheduling_code, '') AS schedule_code,          coalesce(nullif(material_code, ''), product_code, '') AS material, coalesce(error_code, '') AS defect_code,          coalesce(step_code, '') AS step_code, create_date AS day, coalesce(ng_qty, 0) AS ng_qty, 0::numeric AS add_qty, 0::numeric AS inbound_qty, 0::numeric AS variance_qty,          ('NM|' || id_oi_ng::text) AS row_key   FROM public.mes_oi_ng_materrial   UNION ALL   SELECT 'BU_SAN_LUONG'::text, coalesce(line_code, ''), ''::text, ''::text, coalesce(mes_scheduling_code, ''), coalesce(product_code, ''), coalesce(ghi_chu, ''), ''::text,          date0, 0::numeric, coalesce(quantity, 0), 0::numeric, 0::numeric, ('AQ|' || id_add)   FROM public.mes_oi_add_quantity   UNION ALL   SELECT 'BAN_GIAO_INBOUND'::text, coalesce(machine_code, ''), coalesce(station_code, ''), coalesce(production_order, ''), coalesce(mes_scheduling_code, ''), coalesce(product_code, ''), ''::text, coalesce(step_code, ''),          create_date, 0::numeric, 0::numeric, coalesce(inbound, 0), 0::numeric, ('IB|' || id_inbound)   FROM public.mes_oi_inbound   UNION ALL   SELECT 'DOI_SOAT_NVL'::text, coalesce(o.machine_code, ''), coalesce(o.station_code, ''), coalesce(o.production_order, ''), coalesce(o.mes_scheduling_code, ''), h.ma_vt, ''::text, ''::text,          o.create_date, 0::numeric, 0::numeric, 0::numeric, coalesce(h.sl_chenh_lech, 0), ('MH|' || h.id_oi || '|' || h.ma_vt || '|' || h.date0::text || '|' || h.time0::text)   FROM public.mes_oi_material_history h JOIN public.mes_oi_confirm o ON o.id_oi = h.id_oi) m CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

qc_inspection_criteria_lines.title: Chi tiết chỉ tiêu đo kiểm chất lượng IQC / PQC (ctiqc / ctpqc)
qc_inspection_criteria_lines.notes: Chi tiết các tiêu chí đo lường và đánh giá trong phiếu kiểm tra IQC (ctiqc) và PQC (ctpqc).
qc_inspection_criteria_lines.source_sql: SELECT c.qc_doc_type, c.doc_no, c.material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, c.criterion_code, coalesce(q.ten_chi_tieu, '') AS criterion_name, c.eval_result, c.cavity, c.day, c.row_key FROM (  SELECT 'IQC'::text AS qc_doc_type, h.so_ct AS doc_no, h.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(d.ma_chi_tieu, '') AS criterion_code,          coalesce(nullif(d.kq_danh_gia, ''), d.ket_qua, '') AS eval_result, ''::text AS cavity, d.ngay_ct AS day,          ('IQ|' || d.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text) AS row_key, coalesce(h.ma_dvcs, '001') AS branch   FROM public.phiqc h JOIN public.ctiqc d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15'   UNION ALL   SELECT 'PQC'::text, h.so_ct, coalesce(h.ma_sp, h.ma_vt, ''), coalesce(d.ma_chi_tieu, ''),          coalesce(nullif(d.kq_danh_gia, ''), d.ket_qua, ''), coalesce(d.cavity, ''), d.ngay_ct,          ('PQ|' || d.stt_rec || '|' || d.ln::text), coalesce(h.ma_dvcs, '001')   FROM public.phpqc h JOIN public.ctpqc d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec WHERE h.status::text <> '15') c LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = c.material LEFT JOIN public.qcdmchitieu q ON q.ma_chi_tieu = c.criterion_code JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR c.branch = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

label_eero_print_logs.title: Nhật ký in tem serial EERO theo ngày SX (intemeerolog)
label_eero_print_logs.notes: Bảng nhật ký in tem EERO (>94 triệu dòng, chỉ mục theo ngay_sx). Bắt buộc lọc trường ngày SX (mfg_date) trong tối đa 14 ngày để đảm bảo tốc độ.
label_eero_print_logs.source_sql: SELECT coalesce(e.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(e.ma_vt, '') AS material, coalesce(e.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(e.ma_ban_ve, '') AS drawing_code, coalesce(e.mold, '') AS mold, coalesce(e.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(e.cavity, 0) AS cavity, e.ngay_sx AS mfg_date, e.qrcode AS row_key FROM public.intemeerolog e CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND e.ngay_sx IS NOT NULL
